'''Jamiron''' was a [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Jamiron system/Legends|Jamiron system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The surface of Jamiron was barren, but its porous crust contained [[Hydroponics/Legends|hydroponic]] [[Farm/Legends|agricultural]] facilities.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jamiron was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
